name: AI Team Hub
tagline: A dashboard for managing AI team projects and resources.
description: AI Team Hub is a web-based application designed to streamline the management of AI-related projects within Asure Design Studio. It provides an overview, work priorities, requirements, team information, procedures, tools, settings, and more, all accessible from a single interface.

page.objective: A dashboard for managing AI team projects and resources.
page.solution: AI Team Hub is a web-based application designed to streamline the management of AI-related projects within Asure Design Studio. It provides an overview, work priorities, requirements, team information, procedures, tools, settings, and more, all accessible from a single interface.

highlights.headline: One hub for the AI team's dashboard, priorities, and procedures.
points: Seven views: dashboard, priorities, procedures, requirements, settings, team, tools.
Runs as a static single-page app — seven views, no backend server.
Each view is its own JS module, so one view failing won't break the rest.
